findings.text: the helper consults only the pending-landing record, so a promoted run with no record still reads settled whatever its ancestry; the plan's deliverable names "or whose head is not on the primary branch", and its own second cited run read landed at 20:47Z while the section text records that run's record written at 21:06:57Z, so that population is not covered.

only the merge-conflict shape is exercised, so the plain awaiting-merge branch at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:851 would pass both cases if it answered awaiting-merge-repair unconditionally or the two words were swapped.

the fragment records a three-step signal (ledger row to pending record to pane word) in prose only, though the node declared docs/figures/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/a-promoted-run-is-not-landed-until-merged as a write path and the mechanism is a decision graph a single state diagram carries better than paragraphs.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_promoted_run_is_not_landed_until_merged.py:131 fails at base for the awaiting-merge-repair case, but line 121 injects only the merge-conflict shape, leaving the no-conflict branch at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:851 unguarded.
justifications.evidence: logs/negative-control.log reproduces the defect at base for the same case (assert 'promoted' != 'promoted', EXIT=1), and logs/base-arm.log and logs/after-arm.log record 51 and 53 passed with EXIT=0, though the second test case passes at base too (1 passed in that log), so it demonstrates a guard rather than the change.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:827 keeps the module's comment style and lazy-import idiom and takes pending_landing's record through the same private helpers reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:93 already uses, with no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:827 makes the pending-landing record the whole test, so the deliverable's companion clause "or whose head is not on the primary branch" is not what the landed code reads.
justifications.reuse: no owner for a local promoted-but-unmerged reading exists (pending_landing._settled_landing asks the remote branch and returns a disposition, _promoted_row reads the ledger row), and the addition consumes pending_landing's own record rather than forking a second signal.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 0130129d36..5155b09058 touches only the three declared paths, and the declared reckon/crew/obligations.py and figures directory were left untouched.
